one_liner: Time tracking and invoicing software for teams and freelancers.

auth.evidence_quote: register an OAuth2 Application, also known as an OAuth2 Client
auth.notes: Personal Access Token is a long-lived bearer token created via Harvest ID for single-account scripts, distinct from the OAuth2 flow used for multi-account apps.

access.evidence_quote: The V2 API requires an access token to authenticate requests
access.notes: Harvest is a paid product with a free trial (no confirmed permanent free tier); no separate app-review gate found within budget.

api.evidence_quote: a Personal Access Token being the quickest way to start playing around with the API
api.notes: MCP availability not checked within budget.

verdict.rationale: OAuth2 and PAT-based REST API are documented, but Harvest requires a paid subscription beyond its trial period.
